title: Hrothgar's Landing
body: Hrothgar's Landing is a small island in the North Sea, across the strait from the Argent Tournament grounds, shrouded in mist. It was a tuskarr settlement until the Kvaldir came, seafaring vrykul raiders who sail out of the fog: they slew the villagers, left them lying where they fell and renamed the island for their leader, Drottinn Hrothgar. Cargo they have stolen lies scattered across it, and the tournament fears its own grounds will be next.

parts.body: Orders carried by the raiders show they look far beyond Northrend: a map of the Eastern Kingdoms and Kalimdor marks the settlements their captains mean to raid.
sources: quest 14074 description (island to the north, seen shrouded in mist from the grounds; ship's cargo taken there)

parts.body: Drottinn Hrothgar, king of the seas as he called himself, was drawn out by a captured war horn and cut down in the circle of old tuskarr statues.

title: The Sea Reaver's Run
body: The Sea Reaver's Run is the strait between Hrothgar's Landing and the tournament grounds, and the Kvaldir mist hangs over it as thickly as over the island. Two ships the elven orders sent north lie locked in battle there, the Sunreavers' Firehawk and the Silver Covenant's Wavecrest, boarded by Kvaldir raiders, and between them deepcallers aboard a raiding vessel call up the kraken that lives beneath the North Sea.
